description.p: The MorphologyFX class performs "fattening" or "thinning" of artwork. It is particularly useful for fattening or thinning an alpha channel.

The radii are measured in the filter's primitive units. When VectorFilter.PrimitiveUnits is BOUNDING_BOX, the radii scale with the dimensions of the filtered vector's bounding box by default. If VectorFilter.AspectRatio is NONE, both radii scale with the normalised diagonal of the bounding box. The renderer applies the magnitude of the vector's transform scale on each axis and converts the resulting radii to whole pixels. The kernel stays aligned to the bitmap axes. Its width and height are twice the respective pixel radii plus one.

Dilation takes the maximum value in the kernel and erosion takes the minimum. The default bitmap mode applies the operator to each component independently. Alpha-only mode retains the straight RGB of the centre pixel and changes only its alpha. Numerical inputs retain their scalar or vector float format and use component-wise minima or maxima without colour conversion. Invalid numerical samples are skipped. An empty numerical neighbourhood yields an invalid sample.

field.name: ChannelMode
field.comment: Selects the bitmap channels to process.

field.name: Operator
field.comment: Set to either ERODE or DILATE.

description.p: The horizontal radius of the kernel, in the filter's primitive units. Fractional values are permitted. A value of zero disables the effect on this axis; the input is copied unchanged if both radii resolve to less than one pixel.

The vertical radius of the kernel, in the filter's primitive units. Fractional values are permitted. A value of zero disables the effect on this axis; the input is copied unchanged if both radii resolve to less than one pixel.

field.name: XMLDef
field.comment: Describes the primitive using the FilterEffect.XMLDef format.
